div.head: II Cn 64
div.ab: Husbryce ⁊ bærnet ⁊ open þyfð ⁊ æbǽre morð ⁊ hlafordswyce æfter woruldlage is botleas.
Husbrec ⁊ bærnet ⁊ open ðyfð ⁊ abere morð ⁊ hlafordswice æfter woruldlage is bótleas.

Husbrece (id est infractura domus) et bærnet (quod dicimus incendium) et ópen þyfþ (id est apertum furtum) et ǽbere morð (id est apertum [probatum] murdrum) et hláfordswice (id est infidelitas erga dominum) secundum legem seculi inemendabile est.
Husbryce. Husbryce ⁊ bærnet ⁊ open ðyfð ⁊ æbere morþ ⁊ hlafordswice æfter woroldlage is botleas.

Assaults upon houses. According to secular law assaults upon houses, arson, theft which cannot be disproved, murder which cannot be denied and treachery towards a man's lord are crimes for which no compensation can be paid.
(Hauseinbruch. B) Hauseinbruch und Brandstiftung und offenbar erwiesener Diebstahl und unleugbarer heimlicher Mord und Verrath am Herrn ist nach staatlichem Recht unabbüssbar [durch Geld].
(Housebreaking. B) Housebreaking and arson and openly proven theft and undeniable secret murder and treachery against one's lord are, under secular law, not to be atoned for [with money].
